entries.subject: Radius, mass and temperature
entries.finding: Radius 128 +/- 3.8 solar radii from Groenewegen (2013), A&A 550, A70, table10, HV 899: Baade-Wesselink mean radius (solar radii) 128 +/- 3.8 (Monte-Carlo) (https://arxiv.org/abs/1212.5478): 89,049,600 km at 695,700 km per solar radius. No mass is measured, so GM is 0, the records' unpublished value. Temperature 5250 +/- 125 K from Groenewegen & Lub (2023), A&A 676, A136, VizieR J/A+A/676/A136/table1, Name=LMC0986, columns Teffp, e_Teffp: Teff 5250 +/- 125 K from a fit to the spectral energy distribution at mean light (not spectroscopic) (https://arxiv.org/abs/2307.07559). presentationUp: the display axis is a sky-plane convention; the spin axis's position angle on the sky is not measured.

entries.subject: Light curve
entries.finding: Gaia DR3 vari_cepheid, source 4661266369343899904: 3 G-band harmonics of a 31.056210162235836 d period, peak-to-peak 1.032 mag; the harmonics reproduce the row's epoch of maximum and peak-to-peak amplitude. The page plays it as a veil over the disc from the scene date, phase known to 0.02 of a cycle there.

entries.subject: Colour
entries.finding: A Planck spectrum at 5,250 K, because interstellar dust reddens every spectrum of this star, E(B-V) = 0.11 +/- 0.005 (Groenewegen (2013), A&A 550, A70, table10), and its light changes through each pulsation, through the CIE 1931 2-degree observer: #ffead9. Routes tried in order: stis-ngsl: skipped; gaia-xp: skipped; pulkovo: skipped; kiehling: skipped; kharitonov: skipped; burnashev: skipped; planck: used.

entries.subject: Limb darkening
entries.finding: The disc is dimmed toward the limb by the quadratic law Claret & Bloemen (2011), A&A 529, A75 compute from ATLAS model atmospheres for the Johnson V band at 5,250 K and log g 0.1 (u1 0.574, u2 0.146): a model, because no fit of this star's limb is used.
